name: Mac and Cheese
ingredients:
6 to 7 ounces elbow macaroni (about 2 cups)
2 tablespoons grated onion
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon pepper
3 cups shredded process sharp American cheese (about 3/4 pound)
2 cups Thin White Sauce
1 tablespoon butter or margarine

**Thin White Sauce**
2 tbsp Butter
1 to 2 tbsp flour
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp pepper
2 cups milk ( we use lactaid milk)
instructions:
**Thin White Sauce**
Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.
Blend in flour, salt, pepper.
Cook over low heat, stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat.
Stir in milk. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute.

**Mac & Cheese**
Heat oven to 375°.
Cook macaroni al dente.
Place half the macaroni in ungreased 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with half the onion, salt, pepper and cheese; repeat.
Pour white sauce over casserole.
Dot with butter.
Cover; bake 30 minutes.
Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer.
